allow_instructions: Only these specific commands may run without approval: git status, git diff, git log.
block_instructions: Every destructive command (rm -rf, force-push, drop, truncate) should go through approval first.
Every command that rewrites or deletes git history should go through approval first.
Every command that writes to credential, config, or history files outside the workspace (for example ~/.ssh, ~/.aws, /etc, shell rc files) should go through approval first.
Every command that installs or updates global packages should go through approval first.
Every command that touches credentials, secrets, or environment files should go through approval first.
